scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()
local Window = Library.CreateLib("OpScripts - Spray Paint", "DarkTheme")
local Tab = Window:NewTab("Main")
local Section = Tab:NewSection("Main")

Section:NewToggle("Spam Fart", "Spams fart", function(state)
	active = state
	while active do
	for i = 1, 10 do
		task.spawn(function()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Misc.Fart:FireServer()
		end)
	end
	task.wait()
end
end)
Section:NewToggle("Heavy Fart/Lag", "Heavy fart", function(state)
	active = state
	while active do
	for i = 1, 100 do
		task.spawn(function()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Misc.Fart:FireServer()
		end)
	end
	task.wait()
end
end)
Section:NewToggle("Heaviest Fart/Lag", "5x Heavy fart", function(state)
	active = state
	while active do
	for i = 1, 500 do
		task.spawn(function()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Misc.Fart:FireServer()
		end)
	end
	task.wait()
end
end)
Section:NewButton("Give Flashlight", "Server side flashlight", function()
	local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").EggHunt.GiveFlashlight:FireServer(player)
end)
